audit.whatIsWrong: Six of the seven rows disagreed with their own whys. whys[0] says level 1 favours you but row 0 read Skill; whys[1] and whys[2] say the lane evens but rows 1 and 2 read Wukong; whys[4] calls 6 his strongest kill window but row 4 read Skill; whys[5] and whys[6] say even but rows 5 and 6 read Wukong.
audit.why: packet.levelChart is [Wukong, Skill, Skill, Skill, Sylas, Skill, Skill] and the mirror audit records the identical realignment.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 1, 2, 4, 5 and 6 flipped in both layers as one atomic group, ratings moved on the two rows that change side meaningfully.

audit.whatIsWrong: Sylas's level-6 spike was written as a one-off threat ('play around his stolen-ult cooldown') with no number, which badly understates it.
audit.why: Kit: Hijack (R) 80/55/30s. At rank 3 his ultimate is a 30-second cooldown — it comes back several times faster than Cyclone, so 'wait it out' is not a plan. Chain Lash (Q) 10/9/8/7/6s at 775 range, Kingslayer (W) 12/10.5/9/7.5/6s, Abscond (E) 13/12/11/10/9s at 400 range.
audit.corrected: 80s at rank 1 and 30s at rank 3 written into the level-6 row, the cooldown block and the level-6 spike, with the conclusion stated: never show Cyclone first.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page called Abscond / Abduct 'his dash + stun (recast pull)' in three places. Riot's text has no stun on it at all: Abscond is a dash, and the Abduct recast throws chains that pull SYLAS to an enemy. A player told to fear a stun plays the trade completely wrong. Kingslayer's heal was also never qualified — it only heals him against champions.
audit.why: Riot text — E: 'Sylas dashes to a location. Sylas can recast the ability to throw his chains out, pulling himself to an enemy he hits.' W: 'lunges at an enemy with magical force dealing damage and healing himself against enemy champions.'
audit.corrected: The stun claim removed everywhere, the recast described as a pull toward you, and the champions-only heal stated so the anti-heal timing on the page has a reason attached.

edits.before: Q-AA poke wins the short exchanges. Identify how Sylas contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Yours at 1: he has one spell and Chain Lash is 10s at rank 1, so step forward the moment it is spent.

edits.before: Cyclone’s double knockup wins every committed brawl. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Sylas's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Hijack is 80s at rank 1 and only 30s at rank 3 — every ult you show him becomes his, so hold Cyclone until his is spent.

edits.before: - Sylas Abscond / Abduct: matchup-defining — His dash + stun (recast pull). Bait it, then commit. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Abscond / Abduct: 13s at rank 1, 400 range — a dash with a recast chain, no stun. - Kingslayer: 12s, and it heals him only off champions. - Hijack: 80s at rank 1 and only 30s at rank 3, so expect it every fight.

edits.before: His dash + stun (recast pull). Bait it, then commit. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: It is a dash with a recast chain, not a stun — 13s at rank 1, so punish the gap it leaves.

edits.before: Track Sylas's Abscond / Abduct: His dash + stun (recast pull). Bait it, then commit. When it is down — E-Q shred, W out, R knockup.
edits.after: Abscond is a dash, not a stun; Abduct is the recast chain. Kingslayer heals only off champions — trade healthy, then E-Q.

edits.before: Sylas trades with Q (Chain Lash) detonation and his E dash-chain, healing off you with his W (Kingslayer) when you're low. Deny the heal by trading while you're healthy: Q-Nimbus onto him, W-decoy the return E, and back off before his W comes off cooldown.
edits.after: Sylas trades with Q (Chain Lash) detonation and his E dash-chain, healing off you with his W (Kingslayer) when you're low. Deny the heal by trading while you're healthy: Q-Nimbus onto him, W-decoy the return E, and back off before Kingslayer's 12s is up again.

edits.before: Sylas ults YOUR Cyclone — if you ult first he can steal it and knock you up, so bait your R or hold it. This is his sharpest window; W-decoy his all-in and don't hand him a free ult to hijack. Play around his stolen-ult cooldown.
edits.after: Sylas ults YOUR Cyclone — if you ult first he can steal it and knock you up, so hold R. Hijack is 80s at rank 1 and 30s at rank 3, so it comes back faster than yours; W-decoy his all-in and never show him Cyclone first.

edits.before: Punish his E cooldown after he dashes in
edits.after: Punish his 13s Abscond gap after he dashes

notes: Hijack at 30s on rank 3 is the single most important number on this page and was absent — it turns 'bait his ult' into bad advice, because he simply gets another one. Whether Warrior Trickster's clone can be targeted by Abduct's chain, and whether Hijack can be cast on a clone, are not answerable from Riot's text (needsResearch empty), so nothing was asserted about it. Wukong's kit was null in the brief, so no Wukong cooldowns were added.
